svg.title: Machine learning (aka, AI) successes
svg.desc: Slide listing four generations of ML successes: first generation ('90-'00), the backend, e.g. fraud detection, search, supply-chain management; second generation ('00-'10), the human side, e.g. recommendation systems, commerce, social media; third generation ('10-now), pattern recognition, e.g. speech recognition, computer vision, translation; fourth generation (emerging), decisions and markets: not just one agent making a decision or sequence of decisions, rather a huge interconnected web of data, agents, decisions, with many new challenges.
svg.text: – e.g., fraud detection, search, supply-chain management
